# Archive orders older than two years nightly

This plan adds a nightly job that moves orders older than two years to cold storage, so the orders table stays small.

## Job

The archiveWorker runs at 02:00 and moves old orders in batches.

## Monitoring

Alerts fire when the archiveWorker fails twice.
